title: Potion Shop Alchemy
description: A hooded figure in a purple robe stands in a mystical shop, reaching towards shelves filled with glowing potion bottles. The scene is filled with swirling blue energy, floating golden sparks, lit candles, scattered vials, and vibrant red and teal paint splatters dripping from above.
prompt: A hooded wizard in a flowing purple robe stands in an alchemist's shop, reaching for a glowing potion on a shelf. The room is filled with wooden crates and shelves holding colorful magical potions, lit candles, scattered vials on a green and white counter, swirling turquoise magical energy, floating golden particles, with vibrant red and teal paint splatters dramatically dripping from the top of the scene.
